title: Rust: Template Engine
description: Build a template engine that renders text with variable substitution and conditionals.

steps.title: Variable Substitution
steps.description: Create a `Template` struct that replaces `{{var}}` patterns. Implement `render(&self, context: &HashMap<&str, &str>) -> String`. Test with `"Hello, {{name}}!"` and `{"name": "World"}`.

steps.title: Parse Template into Tokens
steps.description: Parse a template string into tokens: `Text(String)`, `Variable(String)`. `parse(template)` returns `Vec<TemplateToken>`. Render by joining evaluated tokens. Print the tokens for `"Hello {{name}}, age {{age}}"`.
hints: Text between markers → Text, between `{{}}` → Variable.

verification.failureMessage: Tokenize the template and print tokens.

steps.title: Default Values
steps.description: Add `{{var:default}}` syntax: if var is not in context, use the default value. Test with `"Hello {{name:Guest}}!"` rendering with and without 'name' in context.
hints: Split variable name on `:` to get (name, default).
If name not in context, use default.

verification.failureMessage: Render template with and without providing the variable.

steps.title: Conditionals
steps.description: Add `{{#if var}}...{{/if}}` blocks. Only render the content if the variable is truthy (non-empty, non-zero). Test with `"{{#if show}}Visible{{/if}}"`.
hints: Track if we're in an active if block.
Skip tokens inside the block if condition is false.

verification.failureMessage: Render 'Visible' when show=true, and empty when show=false.

steps.title: For Loops
steps.description: Add `{{#each items}} {{this}} {{/each}}` loops. `items` is a comma-separated list in context. Render each item. Test with `items` = `"apple,banana,cherry"`.
hints: Split context value by comma for items.
Replace `{{this}}` with each item inside the loop body.

verification.failureMessage: Render each item in an each loop.
